sonnet.problem: The question puts the meal "at the table." Exodus 12:11 mentions no table. The text only says they eat in haste, fully dressed for travel.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks for "destroyer" with "army" and "darkness" as the other choices. No earlier card shows this word, and a thoughtful baker has no way to reason it out. "Army" fits the sentence just as well. It tests wording from verse 23 rather than meaning.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
